facts.text: Almagro hosts the annual Festival Internacional de Teatro Clásico, drawing classical theatre lovers each summer.
The Biblioteca Municipal B.P.M. in Almagro serves as a cultural hub, offering a wide range of literary resources.
Almagro’s historic core is recognized as a Conjunto Histórico-Artístico, preserving its architectural heritage.
The town’s cemetery, Cementerio Municipal de Almagro, is noted for its traditional Spanish cemetery layout.
Almagro celebrates its history with the annual “Ven a conocer la historia!” event, showcasing local heritage.
The local government’s website, Ayuntamiento de Almagro, provides online services and citizen profiles for residents.
